I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in that channel yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27). He wrote that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he flagged it on #8841 for support. Pree is in that channel, so she could see this herself.

I told her I can't see the ticket's current status, and suggested she ask Tobias. He has owned Marrow Fieldworks since January 5. The brain search found other Marrow tickets, but none for the Door 2 double-booking.
